$comment: Input groups for scripts/quality/release-scope-fingerprint.ps1 (S3010). Each group names the tree roots one or more release-scope gates READ. Held as data, not as literals in the script: assert-code-domain-writers.ps1 flags any .ps1 that carries both a write cmdlet and a quoted Code.* path, and the fingerprint writes only temp/ - registering it as a writer would have demanded a domain lock it does not need, while hiding the roots inside expressions would have been obfuscation. As data they are also the vocabulary assert-release-scope-gates.ps1 -OnlyGroups speaks.

scopes.$comment: S4249: which groups each sweep's fingerprint covers. The phone sweep judges every group; the watch sweep judges only what its gates read, so a phone-only edit during it does not force the watch sweep's second pass.

verdictGroups.$comment: S4498: the groups a sweep VERDICT judges - the source tree its walk ran against. assert-sweep-verdicts.ps1 calls a verdict stale only when one of these groups changed after the verdict was written. The other groups of the scope (docs, scripts, ...) are covered by the gates the procedure re-runs on a moved compare, so a change there leaves the verdict standing.
